primary_negative_rule: candidate median regression exceeds max(1 percent, 2 * relative_noise_floor)
primary_positive_rule: at least 75 percent of paired blocks favor candidate and median improvement exceeds max(1 percent, 2 * relative_noise_floor)
profiler: not planned; only allowed after unexplained scheduling/completion ambiguity
relative_noise_floor: maximum of absolute pre/post base median drift and median paired base/base absolute relative delta
secondary_rule: primary-positive plus two-rank regression beyond its noise boundary is MIXED_LOCAL_GAIN_SECONDARY_REGRESSION
synchronization: torch.npu.synchronize before and after every timed sample; HCCL barrier before and after two-rank samples; two-rank elapsed is max(rank elapsed)
